findings.finding: Production labels drawn as giant cyan layer colliding with captions in 9/10 scenes
evidence: b9_33_draft.review.json scene_visual_spec (visual_type title+description for all scenes)
findings.root_cause: Single title+description template; captions burned at top with no regions or collision checks

findings.finding: Scene labels are production metadata rendered as the only visual layer
findings.root_cause: No metadata/content separation in scene model (production_scenes rows carry label only)

findings.finding: Caption head dropped (scene 10) and tail clipped (scene 5); SRT is complete so loss happened at render time
findings.root_cause: Fixed line/height caption budget silently dropping overflowing lines; no spill/split policy, no coverage check

findings.finding: Unexplained cyan keyword-highlight rectangles crossing text in scene 5 (~894x175px)
findings.root_cause: Uncommitted renderer highlight boxes without declared bounds; renderer itself uncommitted
fixed_by: utils/layout-engine.js (only declared, bounded, authorized text survives)

findings.finding: No explanatory visuals (process, comparison, end card) anywhere
evidence: all contact frames; candidate index has no visual descriptors
findings.root_cause: Scene model has no visual payload concept; nothing routes narration meaning into visuals

findings.finding: Captions at frame top with ~0px margins; inconsistent letterboxing
findings.root_cause: No canonical canvas contract; unrelated hard-coded coordinates; no margin/letterbox validation

findings.finding: Renders accepted by declarative booleans (visuals_explanatory: true) with no code enforcement
findings.root_cause: No pre-render contracts; success path has no quality gates

findings.finding: b9.31-b9.37 composition procedure uncommitted and irreproducible
evidence: repository-wide search: no drawtext/22d3ee code; ai-video-generator slideshow was not the render path
findings.root_cause: Milestone renders executed through ephemeral scripts

findings.finding: Grammar issue 'not that misspellings are good strategy' (missing article)
findings.root_cause: Editorial/content defect in accepted narration; must not be masked by captions
fixed_by: recorded in fact sheet + report; caption DIVERGED check prevents silent rewrite

findings.finding: Accepted narration never names the domain, strings, registrar, dates or amounts — visuals must not invent them
findings.root_cause: Generic retelling; unsupported specifics have no evidence status
fixed_by: utils/visual-planner.js buildStoryFactSheet unresolved claims; fragment-exactness checks
